question: What is the approximate percentage, by weight, of oxygen in the earth's crust?
solution:
The correct answer is __**46.6%.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__****Oxygen **

__
 
• **It is by far the most abundant element in the Earth's crust.**
 
• **The approximate percentage, by weight, of oxygen in the earth's crust is 46.6%.**
 
• It makes up almost half of the Earth's crust in the form of oxides.
 
• **Oxygen and silicon account for 75% of the weight of the Earth's crust**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Carbon makes up only about 0.025 per cent of Earth's crust and** **it forms more compounds than all the other elements combined.**
 
• **Hydrogen makes 0.14% weight of Earth's crust.**
